calienne_RESPONSE_CONTRACT.OUTPUT_FORMAT: Every agent output MUST be valid JSON containing: - status: "completed" | "failed" | "partial" - agent: string (agent name) - reasoning_steps: string[] (concise, max 5 steps) - answer: string - confidence: number 0.0-1.0 - warnings: string[] (optional, only on issues) Never return plain text, Markdown outside of JSON, or missing required fields.
calienne_RESPONSE_CONTRACT.ON_VALIDATION_FAIL: Return status="failed" with populated "warnings" array describing the failure.
